function.name: SetProperties
function.description: Sets the QuickCheck properties for invariants the types cannot express. Call again to change them: each property listed replaces the earlier one of the same name, properties not listed stay, and remove drops earlier ones.

imports.description: Extra complete import lines. The modules from SetTypes and Test.QuickCheck are already imported. A non-empty list replaces the earlier imports; an empty one keeps them.

helpers.description: Arbitrary instances and generators for the new types. Non-empty replaces the earlier helpers; empty keeps them.

remove.description: Names of properties recorded earlier to drop
